description: Manufacturing capability pages — what China can make, not what we sell

page.title: China Industrial Manufacturing Capability Network
page.subtitle: 8 industrial systems. Verified manufacturing expertise. End-to-end production capabilities.
page.positioning: This is not a product catalog. This page demonstrates the breadth and depth of Chinese industrial manufacturing capabilities available through HISVIA's supply chain network.

capabilities.name: CNC Precision Machining
capabilities.description: Multi-axis CNC turning and milling for complex industrial components. Tolerances to ±0.01mm. Materials: carbon steel, stainless steel, aluminum, brass, engineering plastics. Batch sizes from prototype to mass production.

capabilities.name: Casting & Forging
capabilities.description: Sand casting, investment casting, die casting for pump housings, valve bodies, compressor casings. Open-die and closed-die forging for shafts, gears, flanges. Material grades up to super duplex stainless and alloy steels.

capabilities.name: Assembly & Testing
capabilities.description: Complete system assembly with in-house test benches. Compressor performance testing per ISO 1217. Pump hydraulic performance testing. Valve pressure testing per API 598. Full quality documentation packages for export.

capabilities.name: Surface Treatment
capabilities.description: Electroplating, anodizing, powder coating, sandblasting, phosphating. Corrosion protection for industrial environments. Food-grade surface finishing. Export-grade packaging with VCI protection.

capabilities.name: OEM & Custom Manufacturing
capabilities.description: Reverse engineering from samples or drawings. Custom design and manufacturing for specific applications. Brand-neutral production. Private labeling and custom packaging available.

capabilities.name: Quality Control Systems
capabilities.description: ISO 9001 certified quality management. In-process inspection, final QC with CMM measurement. Material certificates (3.1/3.2 per EN 10204). NDT capabilities: UT, MT, PT, RT. Third-party inspection coordination (SGS, BV, TÜV).

capabilities.name: Export Logistics
capabilities.description: FOB/CIF shipping to Russia, Central Asia, Middle East, Southeast Asia. Sea freight and rail freight options. Export documentation: Certificate of Origin, Form E, packing lists. Container loading supervision.

capabilities.name: Reverse Engineering
capabilities.description: 3D scanning and measurement of existing parts. Material analysis and specification matching. CAD modeling and drawing creation. Sample production and testing against OEM specifications.
